label: r2c6
name: obs-sym, identity layout only
hypothesis: This is the obs-symmetry net with the mask input and output maps cut to the identity layout alone. It tests whether, once the obs symmetries are hedged, the transposed and flipped action layouts still matter or just add interference (the 16-layout version collapsed to 0). If it scores 0, the actions use a non-identity layout and the 4-layout hedge is needed. If it beats 0.28, the extra layouts were noise.
